name: Order Samurai Hub Surface Matrix
description: Authoritative classification of every major surface in the Order Samurai governance hub. Each surface has exactly one role, one owner, and one discoverability contract. Paths are repo-relative to the Order Samurai root and resolve on disk. Hand-maintained: answers policy/intent questions (who owns a surface, how it is discovered), not existence questions.

surfaces.discoverabilityContract: deterministic scripts and layer verifiers, reached via `python -m execution.<name>`
surfaces.notes: Blessed runtime. Scoring, verifiers, doctor, runtime_paths. No exploratory or archive code may live here.

surfaces.discoverabilityContract: read-only ronin pillar scouts, invoked by sensei-cycle
janitor/cleanup routines, invoked by scheduled hygiene passes
surfaces.notes: Soji = the dojo cleaning discipline; keeps state and artifacts tidy.

surfaces.discoverabilityContract: human/agent CLI entrypoints (e.g. ronin-local) on PATH via bootstrap
surfaces.notes: Thin launchers only; real logic lives in execution/.

surfaces.discoverabilityContract: hand-authored prompt templates referenced by name from execution scripts
policy + scorecard + surface-matrix JSON, loaded by verifiers via runtime_paths
surfaces.notes: Mix of hand-maintained policy and generated control-plane metadata; the authoritative what-is-allowed layer.

surfaces.discoverabilityContract: proposed reflex/reducer backlog consumed by the OS metric-intake pipeline
surfaces.notes: PROPOSED_BACKLOG is auto-generated; ronin proposes, humans ratify into the live registry.

surfaces.discoverabilityContract: runtime state snapshots read by scouts and doctor; never hand-edited
surfaces.notes: Volatile telemetry/state. Answers existence questions, not policy.

surfaces.discoverabilityContract: generated governance and anti-drift reports, referenced by documentation_parity
score_architecture.py emits architecture_score.json/.md here; consumed by aggregate
surfaces.notes: Generated truth: answers existence/state questions only. Must never be hand-edited.

surfaces.discoverabilityContract: research insights and proposed reducers, cited before implementing metric changes
surfaces.notes: Durable analysis inputs to governance decisions.

surfaces.discoverabilityContract: domain solution docs with YAML frontmatter, searchable before debugging

surfaces.notes: Enforces the verifier and scoring contracts; must pass before promotion.

boundaryInvariants: artifacts/ and state/ are generated_truth/data_record and must never be hand-edited.
config/ policy files are the only authoritative what-is-allowed source; execution reads, never inlines, them.
Every surface listed here resolves on disk relative to the Order Samurai root.
